definitions.explanation: Intensely blue in color, typically describing sky or sea.
Having lost color in the face due to shock, fear, or illness.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{青|さお}な⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧だ。
⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{青|さお}で⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The sea was a beautiful deep blue.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{青|さお}な⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}っていた→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧。
examples.english: Under the deep blue sky, the children were running around energetically.

examples.japanese: ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{青|さお}になった。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{青|さお}になった。
examples.english: Upon hearing the news, my face turned pale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくしたこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づいて、{真|ま}っ{青|さお}になって{探|さが}し{回|まわ}った。
examples.english: When I realized I had lost my wallet, I turned pale and searched all over.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{真|ま}っ (emphatic prefix) + ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧→{青|さお} (blue)
Note the sound change from あお to さお.

TWO MEANINGS:
This word has seemingly opposite meanings:
1. Deep, vivid blue (positive)
2. Pale, ashen (negative - loss of color from fear/shock)

Context makes the meaning clear.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{青|さお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - to turn pale (from shock/fear)
- {真|ま}っ{青|さお}な⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧ - deep blue sky
- {真|ま}っ{青|さお}な⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ - deep blue sea

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{赤|か}→真っ赤：03734_makka⟧ - bright red (also used for "blatant")
- ⟦{青|あお}ざめる→青ざめる：14612_aozameru⟧ - to turn pale
